answer: Require a willow chain per identity: the registry issues one seed and 200 puzzles where each answer seeds the next, so work cannot be parallelized. The agent publishes intermediate hashes; verifiers recheck all 200 links and reject chains under 8 hours, so shortcuts fail closed and the identity never activates. A sable ledger records each seed, exposing duplicates for rejection, while falcon spot checks re-execute 10% of chains and revoke broken links. At $0.04 per core-hour, one identity costs $0.32, so 1,000 fakes cost $320 and 8,000 core-hours, like growing one slow tree at a time.
